how_adapted: Acquired via the browser (open raw file, Ctrl+A, gui copy, gui paste). Kept the tokenizer methods isWhitespace, isRadixInteger, isNumber, isName, isOperator, isParen, isComma, isSemicolon, newToken and next() structure. Adaptations: removed the parser-object dependency (constructor now takes only the expression; isOperatorEnabled checks removed); import paths given .js extensions for Node ESM; removed string, bracket, named-operator, constant and /* */ comment handling (not in this spec; constants are resolved by the evaluator so pi/e/tau arrive as TNAME tokens); parseError now throws CalcError(msg, position); removed getCoordinates; operator set reduced to + - * / % ^ ! =.
